Messaging policies control message features, not cross-org federation.

items.stem: Which TWO channel types can restrict membership to a subset of people? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: private channels are visible only to their specific members.
Correct: shared channels have their own membership, including external B2B direct connect.
Standard channels are open to all team members, not a subset.
A meeting policy is not a channel type.
A call queue is a telephony feature, not a channel type.
